executiveSummary: The Coventry Town Council's September 8, 2026 regular meeting agenda schedules five new-business items, 26/27-11 through 26/27-15: discharging the Human Services Advisory Committee, establishing a Youth Services Advisory Board, two job-description revisions (WPCA Assistant Operator, Senior Center Van Driver), and a fee-schedule change to Ordinance No. 42-1 for fire-safety building inspections. The agenda also lists an audience-of-citizens period, acceptance of three sets of prior minutes, and a closing executive session for the Town Manager's performance review. This records what was scheduled; it asserts no vote and no outcome.

keyDecisions.description: Scheduled for consideration and possible action, with an HSAC and YSAB memo dated 7-16-26 enclosed.

keyDecisions.description: Scheduled for consideration and possible action on the fee schedule for inspection of buildings used for public service, manufacturing and occupancies regulated by the fire safety code.

discussionTopics.summary: Thirty minutes are scheduled, five minutes maximum per citizen; written comments may be emailed by 4 PM the Tuesday before the meeting for inclusion under correspondence at the next meeting.

The meeting is scheduled to close in executive session for the Town Manager's performance review.
